device.name: NAO walker (nao_walker ROS 1 topics and stop)

facts.text: nao_walker subscribes to the relative cmd_vel, cmd_pose and cmd_step topics and registers the relative cmd_pose_srv, cmd_vel_srv, cmd_step_srv and stop_walk_srv services.
handleCmdVel forwards the Twist linear.x, linear.y and angular.z components to ALMotion setWalkTargetVelocity with the node's step frequency; a near-zero Twist sends setWalkTargetVelocity(0,0,0,0.5).
handleTargetPose calls walkTo in the blocking branch and post.walkTo in the asynchronous branch; the cmd_pose topic callback uses the default post=True.
handleCmdVelService calls handleCmdVel(req.twist) and returns an empty CmdVelServiceResponse.
stopWalk sends setWalkTargetVelocity(0,0,0,stepFrequency) and then blocks in waitUntilWalkIsFinished; a RuntimeError is caught and stopWalk returns False.
handleStopWalkSrv returns EmptyResponse when stopWalk returns True and None otherwise.
handleTargetPoseService calls handleTargetPose(req.pose, False) and returns CmdPoseServiceResponse on True and None otherwise.
The node reads the private step_frequency parameter with a default of 0.5.
stopWalk passes stepFrequency to setWalkTargetVelocity(0,0,0,...).
handleCmdVel passes stepFrequency to setWalkTargetVelocity for a nonzero Twist.
A nonzero cmd_vel calls gotoStartWalkPose before setting the target velocity.
gotoStartWalkPose runs startWalkPose once when use_walk_pose is true and clears needsStartWalkPose.
nao_footsteps subscribes to the relative footstep topic, registers the relative footstep_srv and clip_footstep_srv services, and starts the footsteps_execution action server.
handleClipSrv reads req.step and returns a ClipFootstepResponse whose step is the result of handleClipping(req.step).
handleClipping sets is_left_support from step.leg != StepTarget.left and rewrites step.pose.x, step.pose.y and step.pose.theta through clip_footstep_tuple.
clip_footstep_on_gait_config clips x to min_step_x..max_step_x, y to min_step_y..max_step_y or -max_step_y..-min_step_y depending on support, and theta to -max_step_theta..max_step_theta.
clip_footstep applies the gait-config clip, then clip_footstep_with_ellipse and clip_footstep_to_avoid_collision; clip_footstep_tuple wraps it and constructs an almath.Pose2D.
startWalkPose calls angleInterpolation on the fixed Body pose with a 1.5 second duration.
stopWalk only calls setWalkTargetVelocity(0,0,0,stepFrequency) and waitUntilWalkIsFinished; it has no joint-interpolation or pose-cancel call.

nao_footstep_clipping.Params defines the footstep clipping constants min_step_x=-0.04, min_step_y=0.088, max_step_x=0.08, max_step_y=0.16 and max_step_theta=0.5; these bound the clipping helpers, not nao_walker's velocity or pose services.
